entities.name: Worrin Betzold
entities.description: Human bishop of Gavony, Arlinn's former teacher and father of Dennick, who became a preaching zombie in Thraben.

entities.name: Dennick Betzold
entities.description: Son of Worrin Betzold, appearing as a ghost in the Betzold mansion.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker and former student of Worrin searching for the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Key the group sought, given to the Markov vampires for safekeeping.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City overrun by undead hordes, with a ruined cathedral.

entities.name: Betzold family mansion
entities.description: Haunted, decrepit mansion where Dennick's ghost was found.

entities.name: Markov vampires
entities.description: Vampires who held the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker the group sought out next.

events.summary: In Thraben, Arlinn's group finds Worrin as an undead preacher addressing zombies in the ruined cathedral and fights through the hordes.
events.quote: disturbingly preaching to a congregation of zombies within the ruined cathedral

events.summary: Arlinn questions undead Worrin about the Key, but he only repeats "Dennick"; out of mercy she puts him to rest.
events.quote: out of a sense of mercy, Arlinn put him to rest

events.summary: The group goes to the haunted Betzold mansion, meets Dennick's ghost and learns the Key was given to the Markov vampires.
events.quote: they learned from Dennick that the Moonsilver Key was given to the Markov vampires for safekeeping

events.summary: Arlinn remembers Worrin's advice to tend one's own light and that he recommended her for the Archmagi, strengthening her against Tovolar's temptations.
events.quote: She also remembered that he had recommended her for the Archmagi.

relations.quote: and the father of Dennick Betzold
Arlinn Kord , a former student, remembers him as a stern instructor
